The fix is commit `f462a28` (PR #376, ticket O3-5993). It changed the default message in the reports app from `{parameters}` to `{{parameters}}`, so the interpolation now fills in the missing parameter labels. Before the fix, the single-brace placeholder was never substituted, which is why the literal text showed up.

The line that implements the message is `packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:84`, the `t('missingParameters', ...)` call. It builds the list of required parameters whose values are blank (lines 76–78) and passes them as `parameters` (line 85). The translation key lives in `packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json:34`.

Other evidence:
- The commit diff for `reports-data-overview.component.tsx` shows the one-line change from `{parameters}` to `{{parameters}}`.
- The same commit's message says the non-English locale files were reverted, so they keep the `{{parameters}}` text they already had. Only `en.json` was changed here; the other locales are managed in Transifex.
- The 2025 commit `ced1f93` ("Add ability to configure fetching reports without all parameters") is related background, since it's the feature that introduced required-parameter handling, but it is not the fix.
